nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Calendula Deep Cleansing Foaming Face Wash

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser removes excess oil and cleans deeply without stripping, though one oily-skin user experienced drying and breakouts over time.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are divided: several say it worsened dryness, tightness or breakouts, while others with dry or combination-and-dry skin found it non-drying and moisture-preserving.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report both drying, tight sensations after use and, in another case, a moisturizing finish with no dryness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many describe it as the gentlest cleanser they've found with no irritation, while several others report burning, rash, redness or scaly patches, sometimes described as a chemical burn.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers report improvement in chin/jawline breakouts and trouble spots with continued use, with no negative reports specific to this group.

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer reports menopause-related chin breakouts and trouble spots fading with continued use.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers state the wash does not dry out their skin and even leaves it feeling moisturized; however, a substantial number of others report significant dryness, tightness or scaly skin after use, some discontinuing the product for this reason.
concerns.redness: Reports are split: some describe redness or rash around the eyes and face after use, including one case called a chemical burn, while others say the product soothed pre-existing redness.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers with compromised or inflamed skin report stinging on first use that resolved as their skin healed, and one reviewer with eczema-like reactions to other products found relief with this cleanser.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports dark spots clearing with continued use of the paired toner.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report clearer skin, fewer breakouts and improved texture with continued use, sometimes citing dramatic improvement within days or weeks; a minority report new breakouts or worsening acne, particularly after prolonged daily use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers commonly report shine control and a clean, non-oily but non-stripped finish, though one long-term oily-skin user reports the cleanser eventually became too drying and caused breakouts.

aspects.libelle: Stinging or burning on first use

extraits.texte: This product is too harsh. I have used this product three times and it gave me redness, burn, irritation, and rush all over my face even on my eyelids every time I used it. Burn was so severe that my face hurt every time anything touched it... I've used calendula toner from Kiehls before and many other products from Kiehls but this was the first time this happened to my face.

I bought this because I have oily yet sensitive skin. At first I really liked this cleanser, but over time I found this cleanser to be extremely drying and causing breakouts, even though I have very oily skin. I stopped using it. The dryness and breakouts have stopped.
You can feel clean skin after washing your face, but it will dry your face so bad. I have combination skin and usually i dont feel any dryness, but with this product you will defiantly feel dry skin.

I discovered this cleanser in 2019 and I remembered that this cleanser basically changed my skin although it was not perfect or near perfect but the difference was huge. But I think when 2020/2021 came I suddenly wanted to try new cleansers, new skincare etc. so again, my skin got messy and I was back to 0. I purchased a new bottle earlier this year but I used the cleanser for a few weeks only bc again, tried new skincare because I have to tackle a lot of problems and not only acne. Now, I might have hormonal acne and it explains why no matter my skincare it wasn't helping my acne and I was so frustrated. Almost a week ago, I saw my calendula cleanser just lying around my bathroom and it got me thinking, should I go back to this cleanser? It might help my acne even just a little bit so I'm now using it again and Just like how much I loved this product back in 2019, now I got the same reaction from myself because it made so much difference (texture, acne etc). Except for my jawline acne I mean it's helping with the redness but I'm not expecting much bc again, I might have hormonal and I still have to visit the doctor but for my cheeks, forehead acne it's almost gone and i've been using it for almost a week so now I'll have to accept that this cleanser is probably it for me. I have oily, acne-prone/sensitive skin so it's really hard for me to find products that suit me so. I'll just stick to this cleanser because it's really the cleanser for my skin so I hope kiehl's will NEVER

extraits.titre: Best product for acne and oily skin
extraits.texte: Love it ! I have super oily skin and very bad acne .. I always heard people telling me to use it and never had a chance to try it until my friend got me some samples !! It helps very much .. my acne got improved and my skin seems brighter with less redness , I'm have tried thousands of brand for many many years and Kiehl's really help …

I have been using this for about 2 years and my skin is clear and soft! I have trouble area under my chin due to menopause breakouts and since I've been using this that area looks 1000% better and the trouble spots have faded. I tried other products that were cheaper but they did not work. I stick with this and it works wonders!

I bought two bottles on sale. My friend recommended it to me. and it was a wonderful experience. The bottle is designed to be very easy to use, has a spout and you just need to press to get the amount you need to use. At first I thought such a bottle would be used up very quickly but no, just taking a small amount and creating a lot of foam is enough, very economical. It's a facial cleansing gel, the smell is not too strong, which is very suitable for me because I always prioritize skin care products with little scent (because I think it's natural). After using it, it leaves a layer of moisture on the face to help keep the skin from drying out (because my skin is combination and dry, I'm very satisfied). Well worth buying a bottle that you can use for a very, very long time, I'm stuck with it
